children: Australian stocks look set to stumble at the open after U.S. bank earnings failed to quash broader concerns about inflation and Fed rate hikes. ASX futures are down by 0.3% ahead of Wednesday's session, which is scheduled to include Glencore's debut on the Australian Securities Exchange. The mining giant is adding an ASX listing to those in London and Johannesburg. The S&P/ASX 200 finished flat on Tuesday. The benchmark index has bounced almost 2% since Oct. 1, when it hit its lowest close since early June. Ahead of the open, Rio Tinto reported a 1% on-year drop in September-quarter Pilbara iron-ore output. The DJIA slipped 0.35%, the S&P 500 lost less than 0.1% and the Nasdaq Composite fell 0.15%. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
